description: our team Stellary is made up of 5 participants
summary: Stellary is an astronaut health monitoring system designed to support crew safety during space missions. Each astronaut wears a smart wristband that tracks heart rate, blood oxygen, temperature, sleep and stress levels. The data is sent to the spacecraft's computer and then to Ground Centre on Earth. Medical specialists can monitor astronauts' health and notice unusual changes. Our goal is to make space missions safer.
